moderationOutcome.title: A moderation decision about your content
moderationOutcome.body: Outcome: {action}. Reason: {reason}. You can appeal once within 15 days from Profile → My moderation outcomes. Grievances: {contact}

appealDelayed.title: Your appeal is taking longer than planned
appealDelayed.body: It has been escalated and you'll hear back soon. Grievances: {contact}

verificationReminder.title: Reconfirm verification: {name}
verificationReminder.body: Your verification expires in a month. Submit a current document to keep your verified label.

digest.title: {count} new posts for you
digest.body: Open Vyapar to see today's new posts.

reviewInvite.title: How did it go? Leave a review
reviewInvite.body: You can recommend them within 30 days. Reviews on Vyapar come only from real interactions.

partnershipReceived.title: New partnership request from {name}
partnershipReceived.body: Open it to see what they need and offer, then accept or decline.

partnershipUpdated.title: Partnership request {state}
partnershipUpdated.body: Open the request to see what happens next.

reviewDisputeOutcome.title: A disputed review has been decided

reviewAutoHidden.title: Your review was hidden
reviewAutoHidden.body: The conversation it was about was removed by moderation, so your review is hidden too. Grievances: {contact}

promotionActive.title: Your promotion is live
promotionActive.body: Sponsored until {date}. Eligibility, verification and organic ranking are unchanged.

paymentFailed.title: Payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.body: Your promotion order is saved for 24 hours. Retry from the promotion page.

promotionPaused.title: Promotion paused and credited
promotionPaused.body: The promoted item is no longer active, so the promotion stopped. Unused time credited: {amount}.

promotionRejected.title: Promotion rejected
promotionRejected.body: Reason: {reason}. A full refund has been requested. Grievances: grievance@forkhatri.example

entitlementActive.title: Business Workspace is active
entitlementActive.body: Your plan runs to {date}. Team roles and campaigns are unlocked. Verification, reputation and ranking are never part of a plan.

entitlementRenewalReminder.title: Your plan renews on {date}
entitlementRenewalReminder.body: Nothing is charged automatically — we will ask you to complete the payment. Cancel any time before then from your workspace.

entitlementRenewalDue.title: Renewal payment due
entitlementRenewalDue.body: Complete the renewal payment by {date} to keep team roles and campaigns. Your data stays either way.

entitlementPaused.title: Business Workspace paused
entitlementPaused.body: Reason: {reason}. Team roles and campaigns are locked; all your data is kept and returns the moment the plan is active again.

entitlementEnded.title: Business Workspace ended
entitlementEnded.body: Your plan ran to {date} and was not renewed, as you asked. All your data is kept.

workspaceInvite.title: You have been invited to {business}
workspaceInvite.body: Role: {role}. Open your profile to accept or decline. The invite expires in 30 days.

workspaceRoleRevoked.title: Your role at {business} was removed
workspaceRoleRevoked.body: You no longer act for this business on Vyapar. Your own ForKhatri account is unaffected.

campaignActive.title: Your campaign is live
campaignActive.body: Every item runs as a labelled Sponsored promotion until {date}. Organic ranking is unchanged.

campaignCompleted.title: Campaign finished
campaignCompleted.body: {name} has ended. Its report stays available.

contractProposed.title: Contract sent: {title}
contractProposed.body: {name} sent you a contract for {amount}. Review it and accept to start.

contractAccepted.title: Contract accepted: {title}
contractAccepted.body: {name} accepted the contract. Pay the first stage in advance to begin.

contractCancelled.title: Contract cancelled: {title}
contractCancelled.body: {name} cancelled this contract. Any advance payment is refunded.

contractCompleted.title: Contract completed: {title}
contractCompleted.body: Every stage is released. You can now leave a review.

contractDisputed.title: Dispute opened: {title}
contractDisputed.body: {name} opened a dispute. Advance payments stay with Vyapar until a moderator records the outcome.

milestoneFunded.title: Stage paid in advance: {milestone}
milestoneFunded.body: {amount} is paid in advance and kept safe by Vyapar. You can start the work.

milestoneSubmitted.title: Work sent: {milestone}
milestoneSubmitted.body: {name} submitted this stage. Approve it or send it back with a note; it releases on its own after 14 days.

timesheetPaid.title: Timesheet paid: {week}
timesheetPaid.body: {amount} for {hours} hours has been released to you.

savedSearchMatch.title: {count} new for your saved search "{name}"
savedSearchMatch.body: New posts match a search you saved. Open Vyapar to see them.

opportunityPausedSeekerCharge.title: Your post was paused
opportunityPausedSeekerCharge.body: Two members reported being asked for money to apply. Vyapar never allows a fee, deposit or kit charge for applicants. Our team is reviewing it; you can appeal from Profile → My moderation outcomes. Grievances: {contact}

applicantHired.title: You're hired: {title}
applicantHired.body: The person who posted accepted your application. Open the conversation to see their contact details and next steps.

applicantDeclined.title: Update on your application: {title}
applicantDeclined.body: The person who posted has chosen other applicants this time. Keep going: there are similar posts on Vyapar.

precallContact.title_whatsapp: {name} messaged you on WhatsApp about your {job} job
precallContact.body: {name} is on your applicants list. Open the post to see their profile.

applicantShortlisted.title: Shortlisted: {title}
applicantShortlisted.body: {poster} shortlisted your application and may call you. Keep your phone handy.

opportunityExpired.title: Your post expired: {title}
opportunityExpired.body: Its last date has passed, so it no longer shows in Discover or takes applications. Renew it to bring it back.
